milestone: Iterator23: parked pending THROW retains one by-value foreach array
status: Implemented, validated and independently accepted; pointwise composed over 8f11876b0/401.
scope: The pending actual root receives a literal throw method call with one captured Throwable, through finite pure native Generator links to a bare statement yield inside exactly one active by-value HARRAY foreach with a simple CV item target. No buffered input or other owning suspended task/HELD value; getters and close only, no later real resume.
semantics: The native exception operation parks the physical frame before body entry. Its later close skips that finally but still retires ordinary CV/context owners and the cached current through the existing jobs.

Close atomically transfers the single FOREACH_NEXT HARRAY count to request retention and removes the cursor before any local callback. There is no array retirement job or duplicate owner. The closed Generator/source/cursor receipt is nonowning.

The retained container preserves actual COW and embedded reference cells, whose referents may change after every Generator retires. A visited-item CV retires normally; rebinding the shared cell releases oldA before WRITE while newC remains in the retained array. An independently started Generator in that array closes during the request-store pass. The container count itself remains at terminal state.
Explicit collection while the allocated parked owning-foreach frame is saved is Unsupported. This guard does not change old empty-tail parked paths or establish new GC agreement.
source_authority: vendor/php-src/Zend/zend_generators.c::Generator::throw, zend_generator_resume, zend_generator_dtor_storage, zend_generator_cleanup_unfinished_execution and zend_generator_close: DO_INIT/parked exception operation, unfinished cleanup and unconditional CV release.

vendor/php-src/Zend/zend_vm_def.h::FE_RESET_R transfers/adds one array container count. Zend/zend_execute.c::cleanup_live_vars uses the parked raw operation offset; zend_generator_get_gc uses zend_unfinished_execution_gc_ex for a distinct global exception-opline mapping, so wider collection is not inferred.
Pinned implementation observations are not portable evaluation-order guarantees. No engine bug or intentional divergence is classified.
